faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut is 17th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree (M.Sc./M.Tech./MS/equivalent) in Mathematics with at least 60% marks and be qualified in CSIR-UGC JRF/NET or GATE.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email with all required documents and bio-data before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online interview for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post at NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Calicut located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Calicut is located in Calicut, Kerala.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based position, as indicated by the job type.
